pages.text: Tame a bear and let it heal using food in its barrel.

pages.title: Lunch on Your Back
pages.text: The bear’s own food supply supports recovery after adventures.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Approach slowly with honeycombs, then equip the tame with a food-filled barrel. It eats from the barrel at low health. Actual healing is checked, not a barrel click.
